note: Recorded requirements for module PAY (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: DBT payment batch to PFMS
requirements.description: The system shall generate a PFMS DBT payment batch every week for sanctioned applications, crediting the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of each applicant, push it to PFMS and record the PFMS acknowledgement against each application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given 250 sanctioned applications in a week, when the weekly batch runs, then one batch with 250 payment records is pushed and each application shows the PFMS acknowledgement number.

requirements.title: Single instalment by 31 March
requirements.description: The system shall pay the full scholarship amount in a single instalment and list to the District Social Welfare Officer, from 1 March, sanctioned applications not yet paid for that academic year.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a sanctioned application unpaid on 1 March, when the DSWO opens the payment list, then the application appears with the days remaining to 31 March.

requirements.title: Payment credit confirmation
requirements.description: The system shall update an application to Paid on receipt of the PFMS credit confirmation and show the UTR number and credit date to the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given PFMS confirms credit, when the status file is processed, then the application shows Paid with the UTR number.
